title: FlameAntiCraft
description: Toggle the crafting & more in different minecraft worlds (optional: multiverse-core)
body:
# FlameCraft - World-Based Crafting Management for Minecraft 🛠️🌍
FlameCraft is a handy Minecraft plugin that allows server administrators to specifically control crafting in different worlds. It offers an easy way to enable or disable crafting for individual worlds, thus enabling customized gaming experiences. ✨
Perfect for servers that want to enforce specific crafting rules in specific worlds, FlameCraft is the ideal solution for dynamically adjusting game mechanics. 🔧🎮

**Key Features:**
World-Based Crafting Management 🌍🛠️
FlameCraft allows server administrators to individually enable or disable crafting in each world. Ideal for Adventure, Hardcore, or Skyblock servers where crafting should be restricted or completely disabled in certain worlds. 🚫🛠️

**Easy control via commands ⚡**
With the command /fc <world> <true/false>, you can easily enable or disable crafting in a world.

true – Enables crafting for the specified world ✅

false – Disables crafting for the specified world ❌

**No restarts required 🔄**
Changes to a world's crafting status take effect immediately, without requiring a server restart. You can dynamically adjust the settings during gameplay. ⚡

**User-friendly configuration ⚙️**
The configuration file is easy to understand and allows you to use both AltColorCodes and MiniMessage for messages. You can flexibly customize the plugin to your needs. ✍️

**⚙️Installation:**
Download the latest version of FlameCraft from Modrinth. 📥

Place the .jar file in the plugins folder of your Minecraft server. 💾

Restart the server or reload the plugin with /reload (if supported). 🔄

Adjust the settings in config.yml to configure crafting management to your liking. ⚙️

**Commands and Permissions:**
Command: /fc <world> <true/false>
Description: Enables or disables crafting for the specified world. 🛠️
Permission: flamecraft.set
Description: Only players with this permission can change the crafting status of a world. 🔑

Why FlameCraft? 🤔
Flexibility: Control crafting individually for each world. 🌍🔧
User-friendly: Easy to configure and use. 🖥️💡
Powerful: No restarts required, instant in-game changes. ⚡
Versatility: Support for MiniMessage and AltColorCodes for engaging messages. 🎨
